name: Dongyue Temple glazed paifang
basis: Beijing Forestry and Parks reports 20.2 m wide and about 13 m high, with four posts, seven rooflets and yellow-green glaze. The heritage bureau locates it across Chaoyangmenwai Avenue, at the north end of Shenlu Street. Local center is estimated from the native street and plaza geometry and the temple axis. Cross-street depth and the distribution of individual roof rises are modeled estimates.
